column1: # Board performance baseline for validate.sh board / zephyr (perf.py compare).
# A metric that gets worse by more than its tolerance is a REGRESSION; 'info'
# metrics are only reported.  Rewrite the values with
# `validate.sh baseline <board and zephyr run dirs>` (directions and
# tolerances are kept) and commit them with the change that moved them.
# board.O1.*   baremetal board suite at -O1 (board_suite.sh): Dhrystone
#              figure), perf_baseline cycles per kernel, perf_haz breakdown.
# bench.O2/Os  CoreMark (cycles, score; coremark_validate is the validation
#              run) and Embench-IoT (cycles and .text per benchmark, the
#              speed/size geomeans, verified count) at -O2 and -Os.
# zephyr.*     Zephyr apps on the board: mandel best kiter/s, doom median
#              drawfps, irq_soak loops after 60 s (and viol+lost, must stay 0),
#              gui_lvgl ms/frame per LVGL benchmark.  Wall-clock rates:
